prereg: amendment 70 (family C of the 16-concept inventory, amendment 47)
note: Minimal pairs for event/social structure. Within C2 the verb is held identical and only the affected entity changes, so the contrast is animacy and not the action. No emotion words, so a concept direction can be estimated without presupposing emotion; 'affect' and its forms are treated as emotion words and avoided.
